name: HUB Bootloader
description: UDS flash sequence for this ECU's bootloader.

security._comment: All four security levels share one algorithm - four doors to one room, not graded access. This ECU also requires SecurityAccess before entering the Programming session, unlike the standard SLP3 order - see before_programming.

sequence._comment_erase: Erase honours an optional address/size option record, sector-aligning and bounds-checking it, so each datablock only erases its own region instead of the whole area every time. Omitting the option record (routine_erase_send_addr_size=false) erases the whole configured region instead.
sequence._comment_fingerprint: This ECU does not implement 0x2E WriteDataByIdentifier - sending it would abort the flash with serviceNotSupported.
sequence._comment_checksum: This ECU has no per-segment checksum routine, only a whole-region one - see routine_validate_all.
sequence._comment_validate: Returns a live CRC32 over the whole region for the tester to compare; this tool currently only checks that the request itself didn't NRC, it doesn't compare the returned CRC against the flashed image.
